verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a managed inference offering is a single release note mentioning that a new model (zai-org/GLM-5.3) can be imported into 'OCI Generative AI' in a specific region, confirming OCI has a first-party managed inference service, but there is no documentation of its API, model catalog breadth (frontier vs open models), or usage patterns. Missing for 10: OCI Generative AI API reference/docs, list of supported frontier/open models, pricing/quota details, and independent corroboration of the service's capabilities.
